We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support the successful delivery of technology and digital transformation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in gathering business requirements, process analysis and stakeholder collaboration, ensuring that business needs are translated into effective solutions. This role requires a solid understanding of business analysis methodologies and experience working closely with cross-functional teams, product owners and IT stakeholders. This position also plays a foundational role in shaping the formal Business Analysis function within Pronteff, with room for growth Position: Business Analyst Experience: 3-4 Years Location: Hyderabad Job Type: Full Time, Permanent Type: Work Form Office Education: Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus. . Responsibilities: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements Document functional and non-functional requirements in BRDs, FRDs and user stories Translate business needs into technical specifications and communicate them to development teams Facilitate requirement workshops, stakeholder meetings and product demos Support the project lifecycle from initiation through delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals Create workflow diagrams, wireframes and process documentation using tools like Visio Work closely with QA teams to define test scenarios and support UAT Track project progress, identify risks and escalate issues as needed Prepare and present progress reports and business cases to leadership Promote best practices in requirements gathering, change management and process improvement Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field 2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in IT or digital environments Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile and Scrum methodologies Hands-on experience with documentation tools (Confluence, JIRA, MS Office, etc.) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams and functions Familiarity with business intelligence or data analysis tools is a plus Role: IT & Information Security -
